items.name: Field dressing
items.description: A sealed dressing. Restores up to {amount} health. Keep it until you need it.

items.name: Loose cartridges
items.description: {amount} cartridges in a paper packet. Transfers up to {amount} rounds to your ammunition reserve.

items.name: Binding incense
items.description: A waxed incense packet. Restores {amount} charge to the shared summon reserve.

items.name: Survey reel
items.description: The WEST WING survey reel, recovered from its blue case. Bring it back to the refuge.

items.name: Ledger page
items.description: A page torn from the hotel register, the names on it still wet. Bring it back to the refuge.
